task_description: Reduce parallel-worker input bloat (~356k-token prompts) in the Menagerie VS Code extension via a bounded, measurable lever set: Lever 1 read-path junk exclusion (shared denylist predicate + Known_Target override) and a conservative Lever 2 per-worker read-input budget, plus the persisted parallelReadDenylist setting round trip. Implements the APPROVED design at .agents/tasks/parallel-input-bloat/design.md.
